title: Multimodal Fusion with Pre-trained Models for Psychotherapy Outcome Prediction from Emotional Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.18635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-session emotional dynamics are associated with psychotherapy outcomes but difficult to measure at scale. Pretrained multimodal models provide automated access to facial, vocal, and textual signals, yet clinical datasets remain small. Our research question is how pretrained multimodal representations can best support psychotherapy outcome prediction under data scarcity. Three studies use 106 sessions from 88 patients and nine session-level outcome scales (HSCL-11, EPO-1, POMS). Study 1 asks whether deep learning outperforms classical machine learning: a two-stage deep pipeline, first predicting window-level valence/arousal and then session outcomes, transferred poorly (best single configuration, $r=.078$). Study 2 asks which representation and preprocessing choices work best: statistical pooling of frozen pretrained embeddings with regularized classical models achieved average $r=.406$ across nine scales under per-scale configuration

translated_title: 基于预训练模型的多模态融合：从情绪动态预测心理治疗结果
translated_abstract: 会谈中的情绪动态与心理治疗结果相关，但难以大规模测量。预训练多模态模型为面部、语音和文本信号提供了自动化访问途径，然而临床数据集仍然很小。我们的研究问题是：在数据稀缺条件下，预训练多模态表示如何最有效地支持心理治疗结果预测。三项研究使用了来自88名患者的106次会谈以及九个会谈层面的结果量表（HSCL-11、EPO-1、POMS）。研究1探讨深度学习是否优于经典机器学习：一个两阶段深度流水线（先预测窗口层面的效价/唤醒度，再预测会谈结果）迁移效果不佳（最佳单一配置 r=.078）。研究2探讨哪些表示和预处理选择效果最好：对冻结的预训练嵌入进行统计池化并结合正则化经典模型，在按量表逐一配置的条件下，九个量表平均达到 r=.406。
tldr: 研究表明，在临床数据稀缺的情况下，对冻结的预训练多模态嵌入进行统计池化并结合正则化经典机器学习模型（平均r=.406），显著优于两阶段深度学习流水线（r=.078），能更有效地基于会谈情绪动态预测心理治疗结果。
en_tdlr: Under clinical data scarcity, statistical pooling of frozen pretrained multimodal embeddings combined with regularized classical models (average r=.406) substantially outperforms a two-stage deep learning pipeline (r=.078) for predicting psychotherapy outcomes from in-session emotional dynamics.
